replicate_statements: Relationship between rhythmicity indices and periods for various cell line models, distinguished by markers and colored by subtype (n = 141 samples represented as individual measurements).
outputs.replicate_type: 141 samples (individual measurements) across various cell line models/reporters
outputs.explanation: The panel shows individual data points and explicitly reports n = 141 samples, stating that these represent individual measurements, satisfying both count and type reporting.

replicate_statements: Data represents the mean ± s.d. of 6 samples per reporter (n = 2 biological replicates á technical triplicates or duplicates [HCC1806 Per2-Luc, n = 5]).
n = 3 for MCF10A and MDAMB468-Per2-Luc (single experiment).
outputs.replicate_type: 2 biological replicates x technical triplicates/duplicates (6 samples per reporter; n=5 for HCC1806 Per2-Luc; n=3 single-experiment technical replicates for MCF10A and MDAMB468-Per2-Luc)
outputs.explanation: The legend clearly reports the number of samples underlying each mean ± s.d. point and specifies the replicate composition (biological x technical), including exceptions for specific cell lines.

replicate_statements: Normal distribution of subtype-averaged and time-resolved periods (top panel) and amplitudes (bottom panel) (n = 1–4 cell lines models per subtype, see legends of (A) and (B) for exact numbers).
Before calculating subtype averages, all available replicates per cell model were averaged (n = 3–6, see (B) for exact numbers) and used as input.
outputs.replicate_type: cell line models per subtype (1-4), each derived from averaged biological/technical replicates (n=3-6, detailed in panel B)
outputs.explanation: The caption reports the range of n (1-4 cell line models per subtype) and the type of replicate (cell line models built from averaged replicates), with cross-reference to exact numbers in panels A/B.

replicate_statements: Boxplot of CWT ridge lengths from Bmal1- and Per2-signals of specified cell models... n = 4–12 samples per cell line (see (B) for exact numbers).
outputs.explanation: The boxplot legend states both the range of sample sizes per cell line and refers to panel B for exact numbers, and clarifies the replicate unit as samples.

replicate_statements: Subtype-specific polar histograms of Bmal1-Per2 phase differences over time, averaged across multiple replicates and color-coded by cell line. The number n of Bmal1-Per2-combinations per cell line is indicated next to the cell line name.
outputs.replicate_type: Bmal1-Per2-combinations per cell line, averaged across multiple replicates
outputs.explanation: Each cell line's histogram states an explicit n (Bmal1-Per2 combinations), and the caption specifies these are averages across multiple replicates.

replicate_statements: Polar histogram of Bmal1-Per2 phase differences over time, averaged and colored by subtype (n = 1–4 cell line models, see (E) for exact numbers).
outputs.replicate_type: 1-4 cell line models per subtype (built from combinations detailed in panel E)
outputs.explanation: The caption reports the range of cell line models averaged per subtype and directs the reader to panel E for the exact underlying numbers, and specifies the replicate type.

replicate_statements: Example of fitting signals to an exponentially decaying sinusoidal model with constant periods to deduce initial amplitudes (A0) and amplitude decay rates (γ). Dark red amplitude decay trace is sketched for illustration purposes.
outputs.explanation: This panel is a schematic/illustrative example of a single fitted trace, not a summary of replicated data, so replicate reporting is not applicable.

replicate_statements: Relationship between initial signal amplitudes and amplitude decay rates across samples of different cell line models (n = 117 samples).
Error bars represent the standard deviation of the fitted parameters, reflecting their uncertainty as determined by the fitting process.
outputs.replicate_type: 117 samples across different cell line models
outputs.explanation: The panel reports the total number of samples (n = 117) and identifies them as samples from different cell line models, and clarifies that error bars reflect fitting parameter uncertainty.
